title: Stability of the exterior cube $γ$-factors for $\mathrm{GL}(6)$
summary: We prove the stability of the Langlands-Shahidi local $γ$-factor for the exterior cube representation of $\mathrm{GL}_6$. More precisely, if $π_1$ and $π_2$ are irreducible admissible generic representations of $\mathrm{GL}_6(F)$ with the same central character, then \[ γ(s,π_1\otimesχ,\wedge^3,ψ)= γ(s,π_2\otimesχ,\wedge^3,ψ) \] for every sufficiently ramified character $χ$ of $F^\times$, where $χ$ is regarded as a character of $\mathrm{GL}_6(F)$ through the determinant.
